subject.title: [Bug]: childless codex-native subagent stuck initializing can exhaust unified exec capacity

question: What recovery policy should OpenClaw use when a childless Codex-native task mirror remains initializing without lifecycle progress before the current 30-minute lost fallback?
rationale: The current grace window can leave bounded native subagent capacity blocked, but automatically shortening it may misclassify long quiet native subagents without a clearer Codex liveness signal.

options.title: Query Codex status before terminalizing
options.body: Use Codex thread/transcript or app-server status evidence to reconcile inactive childless native mirrors earlier while preserving valid quiet runs.

options.title: Warn before the existing fallback
options.body: Keep the 30-minute lost threshold but add earlier task audit, status, or operator-facing warnings that identify initializing childless native mirrors before capacity is exhausted.

options.title: Shorten the initializing threshold
options.body: Mark initializing childless Codex-native mirrors lost sooner, accepting the risk of false terminalization unless live proof shows the shorter threshold is safe.

recommendation.title: Query Codex status before terminalizing
recommendation.body: Use Codex thread/transcript or app-server status evidence to reconcile inactive childless native mirrors earlier while preserving valid quiet runs.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current 30-minute childless Codex-native recovery policy that this issue asks maintainers to revisit.
